summary.text: Anthony Penland is the Republican candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 115, challenging incumbent Democrat Lindsey Prather in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He says in a Ballotpedia survey that he has served 36 years as a member of the Swannanoa Fire Department in Buncombe County.

paragraphs.text: Penland graduated from Charles D. Owen High School, earned an associate degree from Asheville-Buncombe Technical Community College in 2006, and earned a bachelor's degree from Fayetteville State University in 2015.
In a Ballotpedia survey he said he has spent his entire life in Buncombe County and holds a bachelor's degree in fire and emergency services.
Penland listed property tax reduction and reform, Hurricane Helene relief funding and a lower cost of living as his key campaign messages.
He said his campaign is endorsed by the North Carolina Police Benevolent Association, the North Carolina Fraternal Order of Police and Americans for Prosperity - North Carolina.
